snippet.title: Gridbound Tactics - Demo Gameplay
snippet.description:
Gridbound Tactics is an async PvP auto-battler where positioning decides who becomes your carry, tank, or support. Draft units, match adjacent traits, and test your board against rival player-built armies.

Steam Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4534220/Gridbound_Tactics_Demo/
